summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration file that defines a service called 'joomla' which will run a containerized Joomla content management system. It specifies which pre-built Docker image to use—in this case, Joomla version 5.3.3 with PHP 8.2 and Apache web server bundled together.

explanations.1: The 'services:' key tells Docker Compose we're about to define one or more containers that will run together as a group.
explanations.3: The 'image:' line tells Docker which ready-made container image to download and run; this particular one is a Joomla installation that comes with PHP 8.2 and Apache already configured inside it.
